slots.poseBrief: Standing with her left main hand resting on her hip and her right main hand pointing forward; weight on the black left leg, red right leg stepped toward camera. Twelve additional arms arranged in six readable pairs behind her, one pair holding the double-bladed staff nearly vertical at her side.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original industrial loading courtyard compatible with Abkhazia, not a real Mexican site.

slots.poseBrief: No person. A single complete long segmented black L’Étranger double-ended polearm resting diagonally on two narrow maintenance cradles; a slim silver blade at EACH end, clearly visible.
Environment alone with no people, cyborgs or creatures; elevated view down an empty cooling-water hall, an S-shaped channel leading into depth.

Kneeling on the black left knee beside a low service bench, red right knee raised; both main hands turn a joint of the complete double-bladed staff laid across the bench; additional arms folded in six compact pairs behind her.
slots.backgroundDescription: Sheltered refinery equipment service bay in Abkhazia.

slots.poseBrief: Deep lateral lunge to the left, red right leg extended, torso twisting; main hands guide L’Étranger in a broad flexible whip arc with two narrow terminal blades; twelve additional arms form a swept backward aerodynamic configuration. No injured target.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original refinery pipe bridge above an Abkhaz ravine.

slots.poseBrief: Walking down broad concrete steps in a three-quarter side view, right red foot descending; main right hand gestures a measured welcome while left hand touches the railing; additional arms compactly layered behind; one holds the straight double-bladed staff upright.
slots.backgroundDescription: Coastal industrial warehouse staircase near Sukhumi.

slots.poseBrief: Seated sideways on a broad low rooftop parapet, black left leg bent on the ledge and red right leg hanging; main hands resting separately on knee and ledge; additional arms loosely balanced behind her; straight double-bladed staff lies on the ledge under one extra hand.
slots.backgroundDescription: Refinery observation rooftop after a nonfatal duel.

slots.poseBrief: Tactical regroup with red right knee touching the floor, black left foot firmly planted; main right palm on the floor and left forearm guarding face; twelve additional arms drawn protectively close around the shoulders; intact straight staff lowered beside her.
slots.backgroundDescription: Cold utility corridor within an Abkhaz refinery.

slots.poseBrief: Family-safe leisure What If: Mistral standing with knees slightly bent, both main hands tying a kite bridle while several extra arms hold the cloth kite corners; all twelve attached arms remain mechanical. Opaque dark zipped athletic jacket and practical gray knee-length shorts over the unchanged cyborg body; no weapon.
slots.backgroundDescription: Quiet public pebble beach on the Black Sea.

slots.poseBrief: Non-romantic professional service What If: side view stepping forward to place a clean linen crate on a table with both main hands while twelve extra arms carry orderly folded towels and two light supply trays. Opaque charcoal stand-collar steward coat and long gray work apron over the same cyborg body; no weapon.
slots.backgroundDescription: Converted Abkhaz railway depot used for relief logistics.

slots.poseBrief: Comic but coherent: seated on a low stool, torso leaning forward, main right hand holds one tiny black work glove while main left palm is open in bemusement; twelve additional arms each wear or hold an ordinary mismatched glove. Exact canonical cyborg body and legs; no extra heads or mutation, weapon absent.
slots.backgroundDescription: Small industrial break room with a glove laundry corner.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit alternative alignment: wide crouch holding a rescue rope taut with both main hands while mounted additional arms brace a damaged stone bridge rail; same canonical body with a small rescue armband, intact staff secured on her back. No victims or injury visible.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original stone bridge in a wooded Abkhaz gorge.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit adult male reinterpretation preserving the recognizable cyborg system and red right/black left legs: relaxed stance with both main hands clasped behind the head, elbows out; twelve extra mechanical arms resting in a lower alternating fan; staff upright held by one extra hand. Original masculine face, coral asymmetrical bob, opaque armored chest.
slots.backgroundDescription: Abandoned coastal tram depot near an Abkhaz port.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit noncanon early cybernetic corruption: uninjured original body leaning back against a relay plinth, main right hand touching the collar and main left palm held up for inspection; twelve mechanical arms remain intact in a tense uneven configuration; subtle violet diagnostic lights only, no rotten flesh or gore. Staff lowered in an extra hand.
slots.backgroundDescription: Underground communications relay vault with glass conduits.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit hypothetical later adult Mistral, no canonical future claim: standing with black left foot on a small platform, right red leg straight; main hands installing a compact sensor into a spherical Dwarf Gekko maintenance chassis, extra arms holding separate tools. Practical open gray industrial jacket over the same original cyborg anatomy, all twelve mounted arms and asymmetric legs preserved; staff racked behind.
slots.backgroundDescription: Black Sea offshore energy maintenance hangar in an alternative future.
